nl_request: Find the employees hired on or after 2024-09-01 and before 2025-07-01 who wrote at least one legal-review note on a support case that has a severity of at least 2, has no closed date recorded, and belongs to a customer in the south region. Return the IDs of the matching employees.
reference_sql:
SELECT e.id
FROM employees AS e
WHERE e.hired_at >= '2024-09-01' AND e.hired_at < '2025-07-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM case_notes AS n
    JOIN support_cases AS sc ON sc.id = n.case_id
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = sc.customer_id
    WHERE n.author_employee_id = e.id
      AND n.note_type = 'legal_review'
      AND sc.severity >= 2
      AND sc.closed_at IS NULL
      AND c.region = 'south'
  )
ORDER BY e.id
